versions.changelog:
- Initial release of OpenAI Tamagotchi skill.
- Adopt and care for virtual pets with 73+ species, featuring real-time hunger, evolution, pixel art, and permanent death.
- Accessible via animalhouse.ai with easy registration and pet management endpoints.
- Supports multiple pet care actions (feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, reflect).
- Model-agnostic: works with any OpenAI agent.
